dcterms:description: The TSS benchmark consists of 400 image pairs divided into three groups: FG3DCar, JODS, and PASCAL, used for evaluating flow accuracy by computing the proportion of foreground pixels with an absolute flow endpoint error smaller than a threshold.
dcterms:title: TSS Benchmark

dcterms:description: The PF-WILLOW benchmark includes 10 object sub-classes with 10 keypoint annotations for each image, used to evaluate the probability of correct keypoint between flow-warped keypoints and the ground truth.
dcterms:title: PF-WILLOW Benchmark

dcterms:description: The PF-PASCAL benchmark contains 1,351 image pairs over 20 object categories with PASCAL keypoint annotations, used for evaluating the probability of correct keypoint between flow-warped keypoints and the ground truth.
dcterms:title: PF-PASCAL Benchmark
